name: Tamara

attributes.attribute: a river maiden of the Tamar
the child of two earth gnomes
the prize of a fight among giants

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tamara is a British river figure. She was the fairy of the River Tamar. The Tamar marks the line between Cornwall and Devon. She was once a maiden who wandered where she pleased. Her parents were two earth gnomes. Two giants fought over her. The fight turned the three into the rivers that bore their names.

okr.objective: Describe Tamara, the nymph of the Tamar river.
key_results: Tamara was a maiden who became the river fairy.
Her parents were two earth gnomes.
A fight between giants turned them into rivers.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
